text.p: Kmart Corp. announced another series of management reshufflings on Wednesday, including the departure of Stephen Ross, who had been in charge of clothing and other soft goods.

The No. 3 U.S. retailer said Warren Flick, president and chief operating officer of U.S. Kmart stores, would oversee all apparel merchandising on an interim basis while Kmart searches for a replacement for Ross.

Because of Flick's added duties -- which include logistics, transportation and distribution -- U.S. Kmart store operations headed by Executive Vice President Donald Keeble will report directly to Chairman Floyd Hall, the company said.
Kmart spokeswoman Mary Lorenz said Ross' departure was mutually agreed upon.

"With the moves announced today, we will more fully leverage the talents and experience of our merchandising team, achieve better balance of responsibilities, and improve merchandise flow coordination," Hall said in a statement.

Ross joined Troy, Mich.-based Kmart in April 1996, in charge of all women's, children's, infants' and men's apparel, jewelry and fashion accessories, as well as bed, bath and window goods. He had spent four years working under Flick when the two were at Sears, Roebuck & Co.

When Ross joined Kmart, analysts said his role would be to bring more cohesiveness to Kmart's soft-line assortments. But at its annual meeting in May, Hall admitted the company had made mistakes with key product lines, in particular women's clothing.
Slow sales of men's and women's clothing left the company with about $100 million in excess inventory in the first quarter that it had to use markdowns to clear out, he said.

Also Wednesday, Kmart said it created a new integrated home product category. All soft products and hard products such as appliances for the home will be under Andrew Giancamilli, general merchandise manager for home and consumables, a new post.

Kmart also promoted Jerome Kuske to general merchandise manager for health and beauty care-pharmacy. Giancamilli, Kuske and William Anderson, general merchandise manager for hard products, all report directly to Flick.
Kmart has 2,122 Kmart stores and Super Kmart Centre retail outlets in the United States.
